title: Wait Time Canada - Health Systems Observatory for Emergency Department Wait Times
description: A clinically defensible Health Systems Observatory for Canadian emergency department wait-time methodology and data quality. This project audits and exposes methodological inconsistencies in ER reporting across provinces (ON, QC, AB, BC), providing real-time data for 380+ hospitals with comprehensive analytics, data quality monitoring, and first-in-Canada stretcher occupancy visualization.
notes: This is a portfolio project demonstrating health systems research methodology, full-stack software development, data quality monitoring, and clinical defensibility in health informatics. Developed for medical school admissions portfolio.
